name: cavemio-accordion
title: Accordion
description: Sections that open in place: the height eases open, the content rises out of a blur a beat later, and opening one folds the other at the same time.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Headers are buttons in h3s with aria-expanded and aria-controls; panels are regions.
- Folded content is inert.
- Reduced motion: sections open in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Settings
useCases.description: Advanced options folded under each group.

useCases.title: Filters
useCases.description: Collapsible filter groups in a sidebar.

features.title: Content through a blur
features.description: Rises 6px out of a 4px blur, 90ms after the height starts.

features.title: Single or multiple
features.description: Folding the old one while the new one opens.

states.title: open
states.description: Height eases (420ms), content rises from a blur (300ms, 90ms later), chevron turns.

states.title: close
states.description: Content fades fast (160ms) while the height folds.
